description: The player has woken in Aetheria (end of the prologue)
The player holds an Adventurers' Guild card
The player has met Brother Caspian and the orphans
The player passed the F→E trial
Grukk, Goblin Chief of Hollowpine, is dead; Whisperwood is Liberated
Old Hollis has trained the player as a Swordsman
The player has seen the mural of nine thrones (Mystery #1)
Early Act III: Lady Nocturne has replaced Mina at the guild counter
Lady Nocturne has been exposed; the real Mina is free
Lantern Night, Act V: Brother Caspian is revealed as the Red Prophet
